title: First human-to-human heart transplant
summary: Christiaan Barnard performed the world's first human-to-human heart transplant at Groote Schuur Hospital, Cape Town. A 1964 attempt in the US had used a chimpanzee heart.
why: Opened the era of organ transplants.

notes.problem: Title overclaims: source credits Hardy (1964, chimpanzee heart) with the first heart transplant; Barnard's was the first human-to-human one.

superlativeSource: performed the world's first human-to-human heart transplant operation
